prompt: Gold sells hot soup on a cold day
title: Hot Soup Day
irony: Gold, who charges extra for everything, only sells out his hot soup on the coldest day by giving the last bowls away free.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Cold wind rattles Gold's Diner windows while a big pot of hot soup steams on the counter.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants hot soup for everyone but recites soup facts instead of tasting, while Gold counts bowls.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Purple's flashy truck show across the road pulls the lunch line away, and Gold's soup sits steaming, unsold.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole diner smells the soup and chants together as steam curls over the counter.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green, Navy and Gold wheel a soup cart into the cold street, but Gold's extra charge sends shivering friends away.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Silver skids on ice at the cart, the last ladle wobbles high, and Navy hands his own warm bowl to Silver.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Back inside the diner, the friends chant again while the small pot steams low.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold holds a warm bowl and quietly admits his extra charges left cold friends colder.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides the coldest friends eat free today, and Pink ladles the first free bowl.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Gold serves free bowls to shivering friends while everyone chants, and the pot empties with cheers.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Gold's free soup warms the whole diner, the window frost melts, and Purple shares his dessert across the road.
